name: Open Facilitator Forgejo Provider
description: Installs the forgejo ops connector as a self-contained Node bundle plus supervisor unit 40-forgejo-connector.sh, opt-in via FORGEJO_URL: without it the unit exits 0 and the container behaves exactly as without this Feature. Pairs with ofac-gateway (the connector attaches to the team Gateway's child socket).

configPath.description: Connector config the unit starts with; FORGEJO_CONNECTOR_CONFIG env overrides at runtime.
